rationale.campaign_length: 60直接定义含互斥路线，独特分支延伸很长。
rationale.colonization: 寒地殖民和前哨发展会造成实际等待。
rationale.complexity: 互斥任务段、法术研究、前哨和教派计数交织。
rationale.dark_story: 深坑囚禁、死亡威胁和骸骨威慑有明确文本。
rationale.difficulty: 资源和时序管理较多，部分工程成本仍待核，非实测难度。
rationale.diplomacy: 旧盟友关系与教派政治有作用，战争主轴更强。
rationale.early_pressure: 冬庭对抗与基础设施准备形成压力，未实机量化。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 御寒仪式、腐烂教派与特殊魔法工程改变整个国家路线。
rationale.narrative_density: 圣战瓦解、恢复地位、教派夺权与改名构成连续叙事。
rationale.tall_play: 城市、法师塔、据点与研究需要经营，但非纯高发展国家。
rationale.trade_economy: 铁矿、港口和设施支持推进，贸易并非主线。
rationale.warfare: 北方圣战、秋庭竞争与后期跨区域扩张是主循环。

identity.appearance: 1444秋庭神权国；图查克文化、达布拉奇首都，腐烂教派选择决定任务路线。
identity.formation_scope: H14独特路线同Tag可改称流哈格卡尔、巴瑙查德；未接受腐烂者另可满足通用条件形成H21奥尔丹德，改Tag并换树；两种路线互斥。
successors: H21（条件性形成改道，非腐烂主线续篇）

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text:
福查尔海域北部的寒冷海岸一直是秋冬王庭之间的战场，但直到冬季圣战军之前，处在图查克人的掌控之下的只有达布拉奇城和其他少量领地。几个世纪以来，埃查德一直是秋庭的堡垒，抵御着无情的寒风，直到命运将其推向伟大。图查克人最痛恨的宿敌斯内克鲍奇人沉溺于虚假的安全感，认为图查克人只会在堡垒里龟缩到冬天结束，不足为惧。但埃查德制定了一个计划，它从道尔库特的秋庭宫获得支持，召集了一支庞大的信徒大军。这宣告者一场旨在彻底结束冬季的圣战的开始：一旦斯内克鲍奇人和他们的土地被埃查德和他们的盟友征服，他们就可以结束冬庭的异端信仰，永远终结这个讨厌的季节！

冬季圣战军赢得了一个又一个胜利，粉碎了冬庭军队，夺取了东方的土地，也就是后来建立起的乔尔加希尔和斯莱格卡尔。在冬庭剩余势力只剩下盖姆拉德库特之时，埃查德的埃斯巴格，安德拉尔·丰获皇冠，知道盟友觊觎着自己征服的土地，因此试图迫使他们在誓约之地明瑙拉克向自己宣誓效忠。事实证明，这是一个灾难性的错误，因为他们在那里遭到了斯特鲁特马的佩塔尔人的伏击，而冬季圣战军的团结也随着安德拉尔·丰获皇冠的暴毙而瓦解。

在明瑙拉克伏击战之后，冬季圣战军的残余领袖们迅速巩固权力，夺取了征服土地的控制权，建立了乔尔加希尔和斯莱格卡尔两个叛变国家。尽管埃查德将其看作逃兵，但他们并没有公开表明，反而一直尝试与两国保持友好关系，试图重新获得自己曾经拥有的影响力，不过这一直只是徒劳。
description.text_en:
The cold shores of the northern Fogharabh have long been a battleground between the Autumn and Winter Courts, but until the Hibernal Crusade only the city of Darblath and a few other possessions could remain under the hands of the Tuathak. Eighard stood as the bulwark of the Autumn Court against the unrelenting wintry winds for centuries, until matters of fate thrust them into greatness. Their hated enemies, the Snecboth, were lulled into a feeling of false safety, believing that they had nothing to fear from the Tuathak who cowered in their fortresses until the end of winter. Eighard developed a plan, gathering support from the old Autumn Court of Dorcurt and gathering a vast army of the faithful. A holy war to end the Winter once and for all was declared: once the Snecboth and their lands were conquered by Eighard and their allies, they could end their idolatry and cease the hated season forever!

The Hibernal Crusade won victory after victory, crushing the Winter Court and seizing the lands eastward towards what would become Jhorgashirr and Slegcal. All that remained was Gemradcurt, but the Esbagg of Eighard, Andrall Harvestcrown, knew that their allies would seize their conquered lands and sought to force their loyalty at Minnorac, the Field of Oaths. This proved to be a cataclysmic mistake, for they were ambushed there by the Strutmar Peitar and the unity of the Hibernal Crusade was shattered with the death of Esbagg Andrall Harvestcrown.

Following the ambush at Minnorac, the remaining leadership of the Hibernal Crusade rushed to consolidate power and seized control of the conquered lands, forming the traitorous states of Jhorgashirr and Slegcal. While Eigharders view them as deserters, they do not show this openly, and their government has maintained friendly relations with them in a vain attempt to regain the influence they once held.

description.text: 达布拉奇饱受寒风与海浪的持续璀璨，是个寒冷而沉闷的地方。然而，情况本可能更糟——埃查德人所面对的严酷环境，反而让他们习得了独特的法术。秋庭的传统魔法技艺在被他们掌握后得到了重新定义：尽管万物终须改变，如同秋日终结时的落叶般不可逆转，但或许这种改变可以推迟一些。温暖仪式是埃查德人最早创造的法术之一，需要至少十二名德鲁伊组成的团队保持高度专注且不间断地施法。多年来，温暖仪式一直充当着埃查德人抵御寒冷的屏障，却始终不足以将海湾的寒冬彻底阻隔在外。
description.text_en: Battered by the incessant frigid winds and waves, Darblath is a cold and mirthless place. Yet, it could be worse, for the hardships the Eigharders face have bestowed unto them unique spells and incantations. The traditional magical arts of the Autumn Court have been mastered and redefined: although all things must change like how the leaves change in the end of Autumn, perhaps it could be put off until later. The Warmth Rites were some of the first Eigharder spells, requiring intense and uninterrupted concentration by a team of no less than twelve druids. Over many years the Warmth Rites have acted as a ward against the cold, but have never been enough to keep old Winter at bay.

description.text: 埃查德的第二项法术创举让图查克军团得以在荒凉的北方荒原上坚持作战。只有在达布拉奇的驱冰场——一座深藏在埃斯巴格城堡的重重守卫之后的隐秘建筑里，才能制备这些附魔装备，以确保其独门技艺永不外传。驱冰装备乍一看和普通盔甲没什么不同，但若表面出现刮痕或裂痕，便会显露出内里的晶莹光泽。穿戴驱冰装备能为使用者带来一种暖化效果：虽不足以让军队在严寒中无限行动，却足以让埃查德的军团完全成功地实现复杂的军事机动。
description.text_en: The second magical innovation of Eighard has permitted their Tuathak Legions to persist in the desolate northern wilderness. Only at the Icewardery of Darblath, a secluded building guarded far behind the Esbagg's fortress, are these enchantments prepared to ensure the exclusivity of their technique continues. Icewarded equipment often appear plain at first sight, no different from common armor, but beneath its surface are revealed a gleaming sheen on scratches or splinters. Donning icewarded equipment produces a warming effect on the wearer: while not enough to allow unlimited action in freezing temperatures, it is enough to permit Eighard's legions full ability to complete their complex and successful maneuvers.

description.text: 与可恶的冬天进行的永恒斗争需要对所有可用资源的铁腕控制，这促使了冬季征用原则的产生。在战争期间，埃查德的埃斯巴格可以没收战争所需的任何东西，虽然承诺战后会归还或补偿征收的土地或资源，但任何可疑的异端案件将受到严厉处理。在埃查德，面对冬季征用最明智的做法是自愿献上任何财产，因为在多年的执行中，几乎所有拒绝者都会被认定为冬庭间谍而被处决。
description.text_en: The eternal struggle against the hated Winter has required an iron grip on all available resources, spurring the creation of the Hibernal Requisitions doctrine. During wartime, the Esbagg of Eighard may seize anything that is required for the war effort on the condition that the land or resource is returned or repaid, but any suspected cases of heresy will be dealt with harshly. When in Eighard it is wise to willingly surrender anything required for the Hibernal Requisition, as throughout its many years of usage almost all who refuse have been found and executed as Wintry informants.

description.text: 达布拉奇港阴冷的天气反映在它的主要出口产品上：暗灰色、蓝色和棕色染料。北方腹地提供了这些染料的丰富来源，从树皮中碾碎，从臭气熏天的大桶里的土壤中压榨出来。这些暗淡的颜色已经成为埃查德人的骄傲遗产，他们声称这展现了他们的谦逊和实用主义。然而，他们很快又夸口说，他们的染料比斯格拉德的花哨鲜艳的染料要好得多，更不用说达尔克蒂尔的鲜艳粉红色了！
description.text_en: The bleak weather of Darblath harbor is reflected in its chief export: muted gray, blue, and brown dyes. The boreal hinterlands provide a bountiful source of these dyes, crushed from bark and squeezed from soil in stinking vats. These muted colors have become a proud heritage of Eigharders, claiming that it shows their humility and practicality. However, they are quick to boast that their dyes are far superior, and more plentiful, than Sglard's foppish bright dyes, not to even mention the garish pink of Dearktir!

description.text: 达布拉奇及其近郊之外的任何偏僻道路上，都有斯内克鲍奇掠夺者出没，威胁着我们的生存。调动军队对付这种威胁是不现实的，因为一眨眼的功夫，他们就会遁入冰冻的树林里，然后很快地卷土重来。为了应对这种威胁，北方警戒团成立了，他们由新人士兵组成，将在道路上巡逻作为一种训练。
description.text_en: The backcountry roads, practically anywhere outside of Darblath and its immediate environs, are haunted by raiding Snecboth who threaten our very existence. Mobilizing the army against such threats is impractical, for they melt away into the frozen woods at the blink of an eye, and return just as quickly. To face such a threat the Boreal Vigilance Corps was established, composed of junior regiments that receive their training by patrolling the roadways.

description.text:
几代人无休止的冲突和仇恨当然不利于创造一个热情友善的社会。由于无法从与冬庭异教徒的战争中抽身，许多埃查德人采取了极端措施来确保胜利。腐烂教派坚持秋天落叶腐烂的本质，认为这是对死刑犯最为终极和公正的惩罚。起初，认为秋天是收获和储备的季节的秋庭主流，认为腐烂教派只是一个麻烦但无足轻重的异端邪说，直到后者随着时间的推移掌控了埃查德，慢慢地取代国家的统治阶级，最终让埃斯巴格也遵从其教义。

腐烂教派最臭名昭著的事迹是在达布拉奇建造了一座新的监狱——这座低矮却深远的建筑向地底不断延伸，异端与囚犯被关押在其中坑洞般的牢房里，直至死去并腐烂成泥。遗留下的累累白骨被监狱陈列示众，用以警示潜在的滋事者：部分骸骨被堆在监狱外的巨型骨堆作为杀鸡儆猴的示例，另一些则安置在长廊的地面与墙壁，让国内外权贵途经时都能清醒意识到失败者将面临的命运。
description.text_en:
Unending strife and hatred over many generations is not conducive to creating a welcoming and friendly society. Unable to back down from war with the Wintry heretics, many in Eighard have taken to extreme measures to ensure victory. The Cult of Rot upholds the nature of decay of fallen Autumn leaves, viewing that as the ultimate and just punishment for those sentenced to execution. At first viewed as a troublesome but unimportant heretical cult by the mainstream Autumn Court who favor the aspect of Autumn as the season of harvest and preparation, the Cult of Rot seized control of Eighard overtime, slowly replacing the governorship until even their Esbagg adhered to their practices.

Their most infamous practice was the construction of a new prison in Darblath, a squat but deep building extending far into the earth, where heretics and prisoners were locked in pit-like cells and left until their body decayed into soil. The many bones left behind were showcased as a warning to would-be troublemakers, with some thrown into a massive pile outside the prison as example, and others left in a long corridor all over the floor and walls where domestic and foreign dignitaries were reminded of their fate should they fail.

description.text: 奥尔丹德，四季第一次步调一致。然而，并非所有人都服从我们的规则。在内陆地区，甚至在我们的城市中，有人敢于质疑我们的权威，希望回到一个季节的霸权。我们必须竭尽所能阻止这些持不同政见者，维护我们的联盟。
description.text_en: Eordand united, the four seasons for the first time stride in unison. However, not all submit to our rule. In the hinterlands and even amongst our cities there are those who would dare question our authority, and wish for a return to the supremacy of one season. We must do all we can to stop these dissidents and preserve our union.

effects.display: 自治度变化冷却：原始值 -0.1（单位待核实）

description.text: 在过去，奥尔丹德信仰的探险只从危险的地方取回先驱精灵的遗物。目前，必须采取进一步的步骤来保护我们对遗物的探索。所有可能有先驱精灵遗物的地点都必须用奥尔丹德信仰来加固！
description.text_en: In the past the expeditions of the Eordan faith only retrieved Precursor artifacts from dangerous locations. In the present, further steps must be taken to secure our access to artifacts. All locations with possible Precursor artifacts must be fortified with the Eordan faith!

description.text: 道曼德劳德光明使者是奥尔丹德信仰的狂热者，他们和仙灵领主花了数年时间跟踪道曼德劳德。幸运的是，这些光明使者将我们视为奥尔丹德的选定继承人，并将坚定不移地为我们服务。他们会用剑、魔法和枪弹杀死敌人。
description.text_en: Zealots of the Eordellon faith, the Domandrod Lightbringers are those who spent years stalking the Domandrod with the Fey Lords themselves. These Lightbringers, thankfully, see us as the chosen heirs of Eordand, and will unfalteringly serve us. They will bring to the enemy death in sword, magic and shot.

description.text: 奥尔丹德到处都是先驱精灵的遗迹，其中许多仍然有些完整。几个世纪以来，我们的人民居住在这些废墟中，与我们今天的威严相比，他们不过是擅自占用。废墟不再是废墟，至少恢复了一些失去的荣耀。
description.text_en: Eordand is replete with Precursor ruins, many of them still somewhat intact. For centuries our people dwelt within these ruins, mere squatters compared to our majesty today. The Ruins are ruined no longer, restored to at least some semblance of their lost glory.

description.text: 作为灰烬天空之日唯一的幸存者之一，奥尔丹德已经从坟墓中复活。在我们周围，遗迹精灵和坎诺人为土地和少数废墟争吵不休，但奥尔丹德才是这些土地的真正继承人。谁也阻挡不了我们的命运！
description.text_en: As one of the sole survivors of the Day of Ashen Skies, Eordand has returned from the grave. All around us the Ruinborn and Cannorians squabble over the land and the few ruins, but it is Eordand that are the true heirs to these lands. None shall hold us back from what is our destiny!

name.text: 先驱精灵帝国的继承者

description.text: 尽管我们的邻居步履蹒跚，但他们仍然是我们的表亲。无论是洇河人，亚历坎德人，甚至是被诅咒者，我们的弟兄们都需要我们的保护，免受外来者的伤害。奥尔丹德的信仰会保护他们，他们会看到来自季节和仙灵的智慧。
description.text_en: Despite the faltering of our neighbours, they are still our cousins. Be they the Ynnic, Alecandi or even the Cursed Ones, our brethren all need our protection from the Outsiders. The Eordan faith will protect them, and they will see the wisdom that comes from the seasons and the Fey.

description.text: 独立或平行于坎诺的奇械术，奥尔丹德引导魔法到物品的力量毫不逊色。有了这些发明，我们的工业在各个领域的效率都大大提高了。奥尔丹德的产品，甚至是魔法步枪，都应该运往世界各地，因为对别人来说，依赖我们是最好的。
description.text_en: Independent or parallel to the Cannorian artificery, Eordand channeled magic into items at power no less. With these inventions, our industries are far more efficient in all fields. Eordan products, even magirifles, should be shipped across the world, for it is best for others to be dependent on us.

player_overview.avoid_if: 厌恶殖民及法术研究等待，或不愿体验囚犯处置和教派恐怖的黑暗路线。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先组织秋庭战争和御寒经营，中期准备法师研究与寒地殖民，后期按教派选择推进独特扩张或地区统一。
player_overview.overview: 埃查德是北方秋庭的精灵神权国，曾领导对冬庭的圣战，却在领袖死后失去盟友与威望。你将恢复御寒魔法、经营寒地前哨并重建影响力，随后面对腐烂教派的夺权：拒绝后可另走地区统一，接受则让国家逐步成为巴瑙查德。最鲜明的代价，是漫长的魔法与殖民准备，以及教派对囚犯和异端的恐怖处置。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢黑暗宗教叙事、魔法工程、北方开拓与国家转型的玩家。
signature_features: 温暖仪式把北方生存与寒地开拓连成一条线。
接受或拒绝腐烂教派决定后续任务与形成资格。

player_overview.tagline: 用秋日魔法守住寒岸，再决定要不要把国家交给腐烂教派。

values.rationale: 主分描述接受腐烂的独特延伸路线：理念明写将异端和囚犯关入深坑直至死去腐烂，以骸骨示众威慑；教派用死亡威胁夺权。御寒设施具有公共利益，但不能抵消具体人格侵害。拒绝者可抵抗教派，后续居民待遇未全面核清，不直接评善良。秋庭、神权、战争和分解魔法本身不扣分。阶段分为编辑定标，不是脚本数值。
red_flags: 囚犯与异端被关至死亡腐烂
骸骨展示用于恐怖统治
夺权以死亡威胁迫使服从
